 WTA Osaka Final Prediction: Katerina Siniakova vs Ashlyn Krueger 
 Share Share this article
 × X Facebook LinkedIn WhatsApp Reddit Email Copy 
 Two players with nothing to lose and plenty of momentum meet at WTA Osaka for the championship match. Katerina Siniakova, playing her first tour-level final since 2023, will face former champion Ashlyn Krueger, who won the title here that same year. As always, we offer our prediction on who will go home with the title at the 2026 Japan Open.
 WTA Osaka Final Prediction
 Katerina Siniakova is back in a tour-level final for the first time since 2023, and she’s reached here in style. The Czech dismantled Katie Boulter 6-1, 6-4 in the semifinal, ending the Brit’s strong run with a performance more composed than the scoreline suggests. Ranked 86th, Siniakova has played well above her number all week, and she now faces Ashlyn Krueger, who held off top seed Ann Li 6-4 6-7 6-3 in a three-set grind of her own.
 The history points one way. Siniakova leads the head-to-head 4-0 in what will be their fifth meeting, including straight-sets wins in the last two. Their lone hardcourt clash also went her way: a 6-3 2-6 6-2 result in Adelaide last year.
 Krueger, ranked 55th, arrives as the rankings favourite and has been impressive all week, so this is no formality. But Siniakova has ignored the numbers since Monday, and the tennis she is producing gives her a real chance to finish the job. Expect Krueger to push, and expect the Czech to have the answers.

 Prediction: Siniakova in 2
